name: Distributed Tracing & OpenTelemetry APM Backends
description: Empirical benchmarks evaluating open-source distributed tracing backends, OpenTelemetry (OTel) span ingestion throughput, and cloud storage footprints against commercial APM vendors (Dynatrace, Honeycomb.io, Datadog).

repositories.name: Jaeger
repositories.highlight: CNCF graduated distributed tracing platform with sub-millisecond trace search, adaptive sampling, and native OTLP ingest.

repositories.name: Zipkin
repositories.highlight: Battle-tested distributed tracing framework with Cassandra, Elasticsearch, and MySQL storage backends.

repositories.name: Grafana Tempo
repositories.highlight: High-volume, minimal-dependency distributed tracing backend writing directly to S3/GCS object storage without indexing overhead.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: Dynatrace Enterprise
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Complex host-unit math, aggressive per-host licensing, and costly distributed tracing ingest overages.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: Honeycomb.io Enterprise
commercial_alternatives_replaced.typical_pricing: $1,500 - $4,000+/mo based on event volume and query concurrency
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Strict monthly event volume caps, steep overage penalties, and closed SaaS data retention.
